notes.title: Type:Rider is available on Steam!
notes.content:
Published by BulkyPix and developed by Ex Nihilo in association with ARTE France, the platformer Type:Rider is the latest indie phenomenon. We're happy to announce that the game is finally available on Steam. 

Immerse yourself in this enchanting experience to uncover the history and secrets of fonts and characters! 

Play as two dots and travel through the ages of typographic styles and techniques. 
From the rock paintings of prehistoric times to Pixel Art of the 2000’s, solve all the riddles by riding the most popular fonts and characters (Garamond, Helvetica, Times New Roman, Pixel, Comic Sans MS...) with a very captivating musical and visual environment. 

Are you ready for a journey across our History? 

Features: 
- Steam Play compatible (PC/Mac/Linux)
- 10 visually enchanting levels in Full HD with a unique sound design
- Breathtaking artworks taken from real archives
- Immersive and intriguing atmosphere 
- Steam Achievements, Steam Cloud and Steam Trading Cards supported
